executive_summary.headline: Agents are moving into governed runtimes.
executive_summary.body: The week’s strongest signals converge on identity, policy, recovery, and evidence around agent actions rather than model capability alone.

executive_summary.headline: Lower latency and broader model choice expand the test surface.
executive_summary.body: New runtimes, open models, and hosted tiers make more workflows feasible, but require cost, residency, and rollback tests.

executive_summary.headline: Evaluation is becoming operational infrastructure.
executive_summary.body: Research, community, and platform updates all point toward traceable tasks, lifecycle evaluation, and portable data.
